zh-CN.name: 交互演示型
zh-CN.description: 让用户在受控样例中操作产品核心流程，而不只观看截图。演示需要标明模拟数据、实际支持范围和是否保存结果，不应暗示它已经完成真实业务操作。
use_when: 产品价值需要通过一次真实交互才能理解。
可提供无需敏感信息的代表性样例。
avoid_when: 演示不能默默发起付费或外部写入。
不能将假数据与真实业务结果混在一起。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
提供一个短小的可操作样例，突出输入、操作和反馈；明确哪些数据是模拟的、是否保存和哪些功能尚未实现；提供重置入口，让用户能重复比较结果。
专属演示：落地页内嵌可操作卡片：悬停抬升和点击确认共同支持先试后理解。 参数：悬停抬升 {lift_px}px；演示时长 {duration_ms}ms。

en.name: Interactive Product Demo
en.description: Letting users operate a core product flow in a controlled example rather than only viewing screenshots. A demo should disclose simulated data, supported scope and persistence instead of implying real business actions occurred.
use_when: One interaction communicates value better than a static image.
A representative example can run without sensitive information.
avoid_when: Do not silently trigger paid services or external writes.
Do not mix simulated data with real business results.
en.prompt_template:
Provide a concise interactive example with visible input, action and feedback. Explain which data is simulated, whether results persist, and which capabilities are unavailable. Include reset so users can repeat and compare outcomes.
Dedicated demonstration: An interactive card embedded in a landing-page composition: hover lift and click confirmation enable trying before reading. Parameters: hover lift {lift_px}px; demo duration {duration_ms}ms.
